category: premium-account coupon reseller (Japanese: per-host activation codes in JPY)

free_tier.stated: No free tier: the shop sells one-time activation codes per host, priced in bands. Alfafile '¥2,900 - ¥19,350'; Rapidgator '¥2,900 - ¥79,980'; DDownload '¥700 - ¥18,700'; depositfiles '¥980 - ¥14,600'.
free_tier.notes: The band is the day-count ladder for one host; the shop's own catalogue page lists ~20 hosts.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the shop sells a host's own premium entitlement; the host's cap applies

retention.stated: not applicable: the code is consumed by the host account

egress.terms: Whatever the underlying host grants. Presoku's Alfafile listing advertises '最大20 GBの速度でファイルをアップロード・ダウンロード' and unlimited concurrent downloads, which is the host's own promise resold.

interface_detail: A web store; delivery is an activation code entered at the host's own coupon page ('Alfafileにログイン → クーポンを開き、認証コードを入力').
tooling: Nothing to install: the code activates the host account, and the host's own client or web download is used afterwards.
chaining: This is how Japan buys retrieval capacity without a Japanese-issued subscription: one coupon per host, bought in yen, activated on the host. It chains with a global debrid badly (double-paying the same hosts) and with a single stubborn host very well.

limits.value: manual code entry at the host's coupon page; bank-transfer orders wait '最短数分～最大12時間' for the code

limits_note: No rate or volume limit of its own; the code is single-use by design ('使い切りのコードとなるため、継続課金されてしまうことはございません').
binding_note: The shop imposes no throughput constraint; the host's own daily or bandwidth cap becomes the binding one once the code is active.

identity_cost.detail: Payment rails named on the product page: 'クレジットカード、ビットキャッシュからご購入いただいた場合は即時、銀行振込でご購入いただいた場合は最短数分～最大12時間以内に認証コードを送信'. A credit card clears immediately, so a foreign buyer is not blocked; BitCash and Japanese bank transfer are the domestic shortcuts.

reliability_note: Bank-transfer orders are manually fulfilled with a stated 12-hour worst case; the code is non-refundable once delivered, and the shop carries no responsibility for the host's uptime.
confidence_note: Catalogue page and one product page read; the payment sentence and the price bands are quoted from the vendor. Buying one code with a non-Japanese card would confirm the access claim at measured.

evidence.proved: '価格帯: ¥2,900 - ¥19,350'; 'クレジットカード、ビットキャッシュからご購入いただいた場合は即時、銀行振込でご購入いただいた場合は最短数分～最大12時間以内に認証コードを送信'; '使い切りのコード'; '最大20 GBの速度でファイルをアップロード・ダウンロード'; '80 sold'
per-host price bands in yen: Alfafile ¥2,900-19,350, DaoFile ¥3,700-24,980, DDownload ¥700-18,700, EX-LOAD ¥5,580-29,500, Fileboom ¥4,280-45,800
Rapidgator band ¥2,900 - ¥79,980 in the search index, with the same credit-card/BitCash/bank-transfer sentence

price_per_tb_month: JPY 2,900-19,350 per Alfafile term; JPY 2,900-79,980 per Rapidgator term
notes: Japan's local layer is not a debrid: it is coupon resale at a markup per host. The interesting fact is that card payment works, so Japan is the one Asian market here where a foreigner can buy the local product directly.

extras.catalogue: ~20 hosts including Alfafile, DaoFile, DDownload, depositfiles, EX-LOAD, File.AL, Fileboom, FileSpace, HotLink, Katfile, Rapidgator
